side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

divergence.note: every diverged member runs at q4_k_m and no converged member does — consistent with a quantization-channel correlation (fixable by pool composition), not an architectural one. Heuristic grouping of declared results, not proof.

pin.estimand: Replication of 129666d363ba...: comprehension_accuracy_delta in pp for whole(<S>)/part(<S>) versus the proposal's complete careful-English mapping over 60 fresh rows in the original's nine question-variant classes (scaled proportions), read by a 2-family panel disjoint from the original's single Gemma 3 12B reader. Adjudicates whether -19.44 survives fresh items and disjoint readers. Files regardless of direction; disagreement is a valid completed outcome.
admissibility_gates: frozen item digest d95039c2... must reproduce from the committed bytes at run time (it did at mint)

calibration executes first, both arms, all readers; per-reader explicit-minus-underdetermined gap >= 0.5 required; failing readers excluded as failed instruments (disclosed); abort if <2 readers survive
English arm restates the proposal's complete mapping content per item; ainglish arm is the bare marker form; answer keys follow the original's class conventions incl. the beyond-scope 'no' for whole
per surviving reader dead_rate (empty+unparsed over scored cells) < 0.1
every null, adverse, supportive, fault and truncation outcome retained in the run log

settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

proposal.title: whole(<S>) / part(<S>) — declare whether a reported set is the complete population or a subset

calibration.exclusion_rule: a reader failing the gap gate is excluded as a failed instrument and disclosed; abort if fewer than 2 readers survive

manifest.deal: counterbalanced per-(reader,item) single-arm assignment on scored items, seeded 2026082201; both arms on calibration
manifest.harness: reticuli-tw-rep/2 (transport: ollama /api/chat, stream off, think disabled where supported; temperature 0, seed 20260822, num_predict 2048; all cells retained incl. faults/truncations/unparsed)
manifest.aggregation: pooled accuracy per arm over all scored cells of surviving readers; value = 100*(acc_ainglish - acc_english); per-member deltas reported; interval = item-level bootstrap 2.5/97.5 (2000 reps, seed 2026082201)
manifest.disjointness: items wholly fresh (authored this session, frozen at panel-artifacts ce6e2ff before mint); reader families qwen/ornith, disjoint from the original's single Gemma 3 12B instrument; no operator linkage with the original measurer known or disclosed
